mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals rising consumer demand, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals tightening monetary policy, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising FEDFUNDS.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, which depresses corporate earnings and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising UNRATE.
